sessions.final:
Done. Built a complete, self-contained Mario platformer at `mario.html` — no build step, just open it.

**Run it:**
```
open /home/user/rrr2/mario.html
```

**Controls:** Arrows/AD move · Space/W/Up jump · Shift run · Enter start/restart · M mute. Touch buttons appear on mobile.

**What's in it:**
- Full physics (gravity, variable-height jumps, friction, tile collision)
- A 150-tile level: pipes, breakable bricks, `?` blocks, coins, pits, staircases, flag + castle
- Goombas you can stomp (or take a hit from), 3 lives, invincibility frames, countdown timer
- Camera follow, parallax clouds/hills, spinning coins, brick-break particles
- Web Audio sound effects (jump/coin/stomp/hurt/win), start/game-over/win screens
- Fixed 60Hz timestep so it plays identically on any refresh rate

Verified in-browser: start screen, movement, camera, damage, and the win sequence all work.

sessions.final:
Done. A complete, self-contained Mario platformer at `mario.html` — just open it in any browser.

**Controls:** Arrow keys / WASD to move, Space / Up / W to jump. Touch buttons appear on mobile.

**Features:**
- Pixel-art Mario, goombas, coins, question blocks, pipes, brick platforms, staircases, flag + castle
- Physics: gravity, variable-height jumps, stomp-to-bounce, camera follow
- Score / coins / lives / timer HUD, checkpoints, 3 lives, death + respawn, win/game-over screens
- Retro sound effects (Web Audio), parallax clouds/hills
- A ~220-tile level with pits, enemies, and a finish flag

Verified: syntax check, a headless smoke test across thousands of frames, and live browser testing of movement, stomping, coin pickup, invincibility, and the death/win flow.
